name: alatas
description: Alatas Car Rental Services desktop and web app
author: Alatas Car Rental Services

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n frontend,electron -c cyan,green "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && electron ."
scripts.electron:build: npm run icons && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder --win
